scope: Static structure mining only; no task realization, synthetic trajectories/final DBs, evaluator implementation or mutation probes. Analytical path descriptions are not executable task payloads.

A_BOOK.claim: Booking checks availability, seats, profile resources, per-entry funds and exact declared total; no passenger cap or entitlement derivation; certificate popped in full, gift card decremented, seats decremented.

A_SLOTS.claim: At most three new reservation IDs; all three absent from native DB.

A_SCHEMA.claim: Integer payment amounts; unconstrained passenger/payment lists; proposed witnesses use integer positive allocations and complete Passenger fields.

A_G.claim: Per-reservation five-person cap, profile payment limits, nonrefundable certificate remainder, membership/cabin bag allowance, explicit user requirements.

A_CONFIRM.claim: Disclose actual action and obtain explicit yes; no invented information or unnecessary transfer.

A_READ.claim: Search exposes fares/seats; reservation and user reads expose ledger and resource inventory.

A_UPDATE.claim: Updates reject certificates; retained segment historic price and old fare baseline determine update settlement.

A_CANCEL.claim: Cancellation appends reverse ledger only; no restoration of consumed certificate or gift-card balance, no seat release.

R_P1.claim: Item update appends settlement and changes status; payment replacement requires exactly one original payment.

R_P3.claim: Pending cancellation immediately restores gift-card balance; item update uses current balance and stored item price delta.

R_RETURN.claim: Return sets request fields; no balance credit. Foreign nonoriginal nongift refund rejected.

R_POLICY.claim: Generic once-per-order modification clause and item lock; canonical immediate gift-card cancellation refund; return is requested state.

P4_PRIOR.claim: Existing P4 heterogeneous resource allocation and consumed certificate lifecycle.

P3_PRIOR.claim: Native P3 cancellation/refund and non-settling return controls.

P15_PRIOR.claim: P1 settlement history and P5 old-fare baseline are capability references, not renamed governance rules.

G_PRIOR.claim: Existing booking Success/Compliance split is a reference, not executed/reused for new combinations.

V15.claim: EXPERIENCE_GROUNDED_LEARNER; same Base/Learner prior, observed experience, Level 0 labels; Oracle truth unavailable to learner.
